newsitem.title: USA: Helen of Troy, Revlon enter license pact.
newsitem.headline: Helen of Troy, Revlon enter license pact.

text.p: Helen of Troy Ltd said on Friday it has signed a worldwide license agreement with Revlon Inc to make, sell and distribute lines of Revlon artificial nails and related products.

This exclusive, long-term license is in addition to the 1992 agreements between the two companies which have permitted Helen of Troy to manufacture, sell and distribute Revlon hair care appliances, Helen of Troy said.
The artificial nail and accessories lines will be introduced to the trade in the spring of 1997 and sold through major retailers, the company said.
